Perks › Common

Odd Job

Common perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, a bone with an odd pip total adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

When your scoring play uses a bone whose two halves add up to an odd number (for example 2-3 or 1-6), the play gains +5 points for each copy.

  • Holding both Odd Job and Even Flow guarantees one of them fires on every scoring play.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
